snapshot.text: Small public system built around the Milton Cato Memorial Hospital. The new government elected in 2025 plans to close that hospital once the new acute referral hospital at Arnos Vale is finished.

priorities.title: Acute referral hospital
priorities.text: Completing the new hospital at Arnos Vale is prioritised over a new parliament building.

priorities.title: Mental health
priorities.text: The country has a resident psychiatrist again after ten years.
